## Why it matters

This infoclio.ch directory lists ongoing source edition projects in Switzerland and allows filtering by period, language, region, subject, and publication type.

It is a practical overview tool for identifying editorial work in progress, comparing projects, and locating editions with open-access facsimiles or databases.
